test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Complete the sentence with an appropriate synonym of the word mentioned in the bracket.

Diseases like Verminosis and Mastitis only ___________ (damage) domestic cattle.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Afflict'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Afflict** means **to cause pain or trouble**.
 
• Damage means affecting things in a negative manner, through trouble or burden.
 
• The correct sentence would be, '**Diseases like Verminosis and Mastitis only afflict domestic cattle**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delight** means **happiness and joy**.

 
 
• Example, ***the kids were delighted to see their father return home after a month.***
 
 
 
• **Relieve** means **to soften**.
 
 
• Example, ***sleeping and doing nothing is not going to relieve your troubles.***
 
 
 
• **Assist** means **to help.**
 
 
• Example, ***students will make working models with the assistance of their parents.***
